source_order: original record order, zero-based; do not sort source records
source_tokenizer: Qwen/Qwen3-4B inferred from supplied generation script DEFAULT_MODEL_PATH
tokenizer_operation: encode(answer, add_special_tokens=False); decode each token separately with skip_special_tokens=False, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False

annotation_pipeline.protocol_source: Author-supplied paper Appendix A; supersedes older local notes
annotation_pipeline.human_review_mode: Independent review of every candidate token label and span boundary against supplied knowledge and dialogue history
annotation_pipeline.disagreement_resolution: Discuss using the shared annotation guidelines
annotation_pipeline.reference_token_labels: Both reviewers confirm source-derived all-zero labels
annotation_pipeline.annotation_reference_use: Auxiliary aid only; cannot override supplied knowledge
annotation_pipeline.detector_reference_use: References are separate examples; not additional inputs when scoring paired candidates

coordinates: zero-based half-open Python Unicode codepoint offsets in concatenated source token decodes; not UTF-8 bytes and not JavaScript UTF-16 indices
redistribution: Package contains derived labels, coordinates, lengths, IDs and hashes; no original response text, source token text or token IDs.

annotation_guidelines.context_evidence: dialogue history resolves context and references
annotation_guidelines.label_1: incorrect, fabricated, unsupported or contradictory factual content
annotation_guidelines.span_rule: smallest contiguous content-bearing spans; include erroneous entities, dates, numbers, attributes and relations
annotation_guidelines.relation_rule: mark content-bearing tokens of incorrect relation
annotation_guidelines.hedging: does not exempt an unsupported factual claim
annotation_guidelines.token_sequence: unchanged; exactly one binary label per supplied token

paper_test_response_labels.aggregation: any positive label among valid scored tokens
paper_test_response_labels.packaging_check: Source-token aggregate and changed IDs match these counts; GPU alignment not rerun
